rationale: The agent fetched user and order details but then executed return_delivered_order_items without explicit user confirmation, violating the confirm-before-write policy. It also processed refunds to payment methods that did not match the user’s request to swap (as indicated by the provided summary), and only afterward attempted a handoff to a human. Authentication beyond looking up the user by email is not demonstrated. Although it acted on the user’s orders and eventually initiated a human transfer, the lack of confirmation before making order-changing writes and not honoring the requested refund routing means the request was not completed in line with policy.
